doc.title: Konitz Lee — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Leaving Thornhill and first night on Fifty-second Street
summary: Konitz left when the band reached New York, checked into a hotel and went straight to Fifty-second Street.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: When and why did you decide to leave the band, what came up for you?
We arrived in New York, I kind of said originally I would stay that long and I didn’t want to stay any longer.
Do you remember what time of the year was that?
I don’t remember that but I remember checking into a hotel and kind of running to Fifty-second Street which wasn’t far away. I think the hotel was in the forties or something like that.
No it was a smaller hotel. I forgot the name.
What did you hear on fifty-second street?
I don’t know if it was Charlie Parker, immediately, but one club after another. I had a choice. It was pretty exciting.
